article_asking_for_food.summary: Asking for food is a skill you can learn. After reading this you can ask politely for a drink or a dish, order at a café or a shop, and say clearly when you cannot eat something.
article_asking_for_food.title: Asking for Food and Drinks

article_mate_selection_age.summary: Mate selection is the process of choosing a partner, and it has its own vocabulary. After reading this you can separate attraction, preference and decision, describe how people actually choose, read the direction and the size of an age gap, and run a short check on the preferences you say you hold.
article_mate_selection_age.title: Mate Selection and Age Preferences
